program.name: Athlete 35
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes to train like an athlete: jumps, a strength circuit, balance.
program.about: Athletic training in about half an hour. Jumps come first while you are fresh, then a strength circuit of a squat or hinge, a press and a row, then a short balance block. Two days alternate the jumps and the lifts. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Jumps & strength circuit & balance A / B, 35 minutes
